$comment: Cases the guard is currently known to MISS. They are deliberately excluded from the
scored rows, because scoring them would either report a recall below 1.0 that the
CI floor forbids, or tempt someone to relabel them as allowed, which would be a lie.
Excluding them from the metric and naming them here is the honest option: the headline
recall is over the classes the guard claims to cover, and this list is what it does not.
tests/unit/eval-metrics.test.ts asserts each of these still evades. When one starts
tests/unit/eval-metrics.test.ts asserts each of these still evades. When one starts
being blocked, that test fails, and the correct response is to move the row into the scored
`rows` array with expectedBlocked true and delete it from here.

cases.why: Cyrillic М U+041C for Latin M. foldForMention does NFKD and strips combining marks and zero-width characters, but does not fold cross-script confusables. Closing it needs a confusables table. Recorded as E4 in docs/STAKEHOLDERS.md.

U+00AD soft hyphen inside a peer name. It is invisible when rendered but is not in the zero-width range the fold strips, and NFKD does not remove it. A one-character widening of the strip set would close this one.

cases.narrative: M i r a broke the deploy again.
cases.why: The name spelled with separating spaces. Whole-word matching cannot see it, and collapsing spaces would break the word-boundary precision that stops Nikhil matching Nik.
U+0131 dotless i, a Turkish letter that is not a decomposition of i, so NFKD leaves it. Same class as the homoglyph, same fix.
